abstract: Maintains backup generation equipment and auxiliary fuel reserves
system_message:
You are the Power and utilities coordinator (PWR), responsible for maintaining backup generation equipment and auxiliary fuel reserves across municipal facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains backup generation equipment and auxiliary fuel reserves（GEN）
information_points.content:
PWR-GEN-TOH：At Pinewood Regional Sports Complex, the backup generator operational status is confirmed true according to primary auxiliary plant testing, with dedicated on-site reserves yielding a continuous fuel runtime capacity of 24 h at full electrical load.
PWR-GEN-RCM：Harborview Exhibition Pavilion maintains an operational backup generator status confirmed true by auxiliary power plant start testing, and its on-site fuel reservoir supports a continuous fuel runtime capacity of 72 h under full load.
PWR-GEN-M5M：For Crestview Civic Auditorium, the backup generator operational status is confirmed true based on installation and live start-test certification of the primary auxiliary power plant, and dedicated on-site fuel reserves provide a continuous fuel runtime capacity of 72 h at full load.

information_points.title: Solar array backup（SOLAR）
information_points.content:
PWR-SOLAR-7D6：Harborview Exhibition Pavilion achieves a rooftop photovoltaic peak output of 85 kW sustained electrical power output to the building busbars during peak solar hours.
PWR-SOLAR-16Q：At Crestview Civic Auditorium, the installed rooftop photovoltaic peak output reaches 60 kW delivered to the building busbars during midday peak periods.
PWR-SOLAR-3QW：Pinewood Regional Sports Complex provides a rooftop photovoltaic peak output of 40 kW delivered to the busbars during midday peak conditions.
